title: Travel-Day Benefits and Change Fee Waivers for Wanderlane Traveller Club Members
content:
This briefing sets out what a participating airline handler or property honours for a traveller holding a Wanderlane Traveller Club tier, and how a waived change fee is spent.

**Benefits granted at the moment of travel.** Free checked bags, priority boarding and priority check-in are granted by the tier at the moment of travel and are never converted into points or money when they go unused. A traveller who checks no bag on a journey receives nothing in place of the free bag allowance, and a traveller who declines priority boarding receives nothing in its place.

**Waived change fees.** A waived change fee is applied against the fee that would otherwise be charged, up to the tier's annual count, and the waiver is spent on the fee actually raised and not on the largest fee available. Where a change raises a fee, the waiver covers that fee as raised; it is not held back for a larger fee that might be raised later, and it is not valued at some other fee in the portfolio.

**Benefits that depend on the property.** Guaranteed late checkout and the room-upgrade queue position apply only where the property participates, and a property that does not participate gives rise to no compensation.

## Where each benefit is honoured

| Benefit | Honoured | Where it is not taken up |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Free checked bags, priority boarding, priority check-in | By the tier, at the moment of travel | Never converted into points or money |
| Waived change fee | Against the fee that would otherwise be charged, up to the tier's annual count | Spent on the fee actually raised, not on the largest fee available |
| Guaranteed late checkout, room-upgrade queue position | Only where the property participates | A property that does not participate gives rise to no compensation |

A hypothetical member holds a tier that waives 2 change fees a membership year and has used neither. A change on one of their bookings raises a fee. The waiver is applied against that fee as raised, and one of the 2 remains for the membership year.
